lesson.subtitle: Lesson 9 -- Shopping for Clothes
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Bruna Defrain | Lesson 9 -- Shopping for Clothes

listenings.text: Good afternoon, shoppers! Today is a big day: everything on the second floor is on sale. Black jackets, red dresses, and white shoes. The fitting rooms are next to the elevator. And the store is open until eight. Happy shopping!

Hi, Bruna! It is Kate, from the gym. Do you like shopping? There is a big sale on Oxford Street today. I have a new red dress, size small, and it is only twenty-five pounds! The shop is next to the station. See you tomorrow at six, at the gym!

extra_audio.text: Bruna goes into a shop on Oxford Street. She asks for a black jacket, size small. She goes to the fitting room. She asks: how much is it? It is on sale, and she takes it.

lesson.pre_a1_modelo: Do you have it in black? Small, please.
lesson.grammar_point: adjective before the noun (a black jacket) + colors and sizes
